name: UGREEN Cat 8 Ethernet Cable
description: The UGREEN Cat 8 Ethernet Cable supports speeds up to 40Gbps with gold-plated connectors and triple-layer shielding to minimize interference. Its braided nylon jacket adds durability for gamers and professionals who need a stable, low-latency wired connection.

name: StarTech VGA to HDMI Adapter
description: The StarTech VGA to HDMI Adapter converts analog VGA video and separate audio into a digital HDMI signal, supporting resolutions up to 1080p. It's a practical solution for connecting older laptops or desktops to modern HDMI-only monitors and projectors.

name: Anker 100W USB-C to USB-C Cable
description: The Anker 100W USB-C to USB-C Cable supports fast charging up to 100W and data transfer speeds up to 480Mbps, wrapped in a durable double-braided nylon exterior. It's built to handle laptops, phones, and USB-C peripherals with a bend-lifespan rated for over 25,000 flexes.

name: Cable Matters DisplayPort to HDMI Adapter
description: The Cable Matters DisplayPort to HDMI Adapter enables a DisplayPort-equipped PC or graphics card to output to an HDMI display at resolutions up to 4K at 30Hz. Its compact, gold-plated connector design ensures a reliable, corrosion-resistant connection.

name: Belkin USB-C 7-in-1 Multiport Hub
description: The Belkin USB-C 7-in-1 Multiport Hub expands a single USB-C port into HDMI, USB-A, SD/microSD card readers, and 100W pass-through charging. It's a compact docking solution for laptop users who need multiple peripherals connected simultaneously.

name: TP-Link USB 3.0 to Gigabit Ethernet Adapter
description: The TP-Link USB 3.0 to Gigabit Ethernet Adapter adds a reliable wired network connection to laptops lacking a built-in Ethernet port, supporting speeds up to 1000Mbps. Its plug-and-play design works across Windows, macOS, and Linux without additional drivers in most cases.

name: Baseus USB-C to Lightning Fast Charge Cable
description: The Baseus USB-C to Lightning Fast Charge Cable supports Power Delivery fast charging for compatible devices, wrapped in a durable braided exterior rated for extended daily use. Its reinforced connector joints are designed to resist fraying at common stress points.

name: UGREEN USB-C to HDMI 4K Cable
description: The UGREEN USB-C to HDMI 4K Cable transmits video directly from USB-C laptops and phones to HDMI displays at up to 4K/60Hz resolution. Its aluminum alloy connector shells and gold-plated contacts help maintain a stable, high-bandwidth signal.

name: Anker PowerExpand 8-in-1 USB-C Hub
description: The Anker PowerExpand 8-in-1 USB-C Hub consolidates HDMI, Ethernet, SD card, and multiple USB ports into a single compact dock. It's designed for creators and remote workers who need to connect a full peripheral setup through one USB-C port.

name: StarTech USB-C to VGA Adapter
description: The StarTech USB-C to VGA Adapter lets modern USB-C laptops connect to legacy VGA projectors and monitors at resolutions up to 1080p. Its compact form factor and durable housing make it a reliable option for presentations in conference rooms with older AV equipment.
